edges.reason: Owned constructor stores msg.sender into the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier on changeOwner requires msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal ownerCandidate before promoting it.
acceptOwnership reads ownerCandidate as the required caller.
acceptOwnership assigns ownerCandidate to owner, transferring control.
changeOwner writes its _newOwner parameter into ownerCandidate.
changeOwner gated by onlyOwner mutates ownerCandidate.
owner state variable is read by the onlyOwner check guarding changeOwner.
deposit records msg.sender as the Participant etherAddress.
deposit multiplies msg.value by multiplier and divides by 100 without overflow protection.
Constructor parameter multiplierPercent is stored in multiplier used in payout math.
multiplierPercent is consumed directly by the BoomerangLiquidity constructor.
Constructor parameter powh is assigned to powh_address.
powh parameter is consumed directly by the BoomerangLiquidity constructor.
powh_address is cast to POWH and stored in weak_hands.
BoomerangLiquidity constructor initialises weak_hands from powh_address.
payout reads participants to determine etherAddress and payout amounts.
payout indexes participants using payoutOrder and advances it.
balance local variable tracks address(this).balance during payout.
investment = balance / 2 is used in payout without safe math.
payoutToSend is computed and subtracted from participant payout inside payout.
payout forwards msg.sender into the external weak_hands.buy call before state settlement.
payout makes the external weak_hands.buy.value(investment).gas(1000000) call before finishing bookkeeping.
payout calls send on participant etherAddress inside the distribution loop.
payout falls back to an unchecked low-level call.value on send failure.
Malicious POWH implementation can re-enter payout through the buy call.
Participant fallback can re-enter payout while its state is only partially updated.
call.value forwards all gas, allowing the recipient to re-enter payout.
deposit pushes a participant then immediately invokes payout.
withdraw performs an external gas-limited call into weak_hands.withdraw.
weak_hands.withdraw can call back into BoomerangLiquidity.withdraw.
transferAnyERC20Token forwards to the external ERC20 transfer call.
tokenAddress parameter is used as the target of the external ERC20 call.
tokens parameter is forwarded to ERC20Interface.transfer.
notPowh modifier parameter aContract gates transferAnyERC20Token against powh_address.
owner is the onlyOwner gate and the recipient of the transferred ERC20 tokens.
POWH.buy consumes its address parameter in the external entrypoint.

normalization_plan.reason: multiplierPercent is a constructor parameter whose only purpose is initialising the BoomerangLiquidity constructor's multiplier state.
powh is a constructor parameter consumed directly by the BoomerangLiquidity constructor to set powh_address and weak_hands.
_newOwner is the changeOwner parameter written into ownerCandidate inside that function.
aContract is the notPowh modifier parameter that guards transferAnyERC20Token.
tokenAddress is the transferAnyERC20Token parameter used as the external call target.
tokens is the transferAnyERC20Token parameter forwarded to the ERC20 transfer.
The unused address parameter belongs to the POWH.buy function signature.
balance is a payout-local variable derived from address(this).balance.
investment is a payout-local variable consumed by the weak_hands.buy external call.
payoutToSend is a payout-local variable consumed by the send and call.value sinks.
